The board opened saying boot is BEHIND current source, which makes every
boot-suite line on it a verdict on the OLD wheel. The repin was refused by

inside the measurement's own noise.

No wheel source changes here. Six m3 legs over byte-identical input read
2320048 / 2321280 / 2323680 / 2323932 / 2325080 / 2326460 KB: a 6412KB
spread, 0.28%, against the 2.4MB band the peer had recorded. The ceiling was
sitting inside the noise, so it refused clean repins at random AND would
hide a real two-megabyte regrowth — both failure modes at once, exactly as
Hβ.tools.cost-ratchet-reads-one-sample said when it was named.

THE FIX IS THE READING, NOT THE LINE — the peer's own prescription, built.
read_cost re-runs the m3 leg twice on a breach and rules on the MINIMUM of
three. That is not smoothing; it is the shape of the measurement. Peak RSS
is one-sided: allocator and OS jitter can only push an observed peak ABOVE
the true requirement, never below it, so one sample is biased high and the
minimum converges on the truth from above. A genuine regression survives it
undiminished. The extra legs are paid only on a breach, so the green path
costs nothing. Raising the ceiling would have laundered jitter as headroom,
which the peer records being done three times already.

Seen fire and seen rule before trusted: at the real ceiling the run passed
on its first sample and the path never executed, so the ceiling was
temporarily dropped to 2000000 — the path fired, printed re-reads 2323680 /
2323932 against a first sample of 2321280, took the minimum, and still
refused. Baseline restored. The ceiling is unchanged.

mentl/9e20729:
Emit-diff of pre_register_fn_sig (m2.wat vs m3.wat) shows the concrete root:
m2 (seed-emitted) builds an sst_ clone before each effectful call — copies the
callee record and appends [key, ev_lookup(caller __state, key)] — and passes
the extended clone as __state, so the callee's ev_perform_entry finds its
evidence. m3 (wheel-emitted) passes the raw callee global with zero sst_
extension, so ev_perform_entry finds entry==0 and faults.

The wheel's emit lacks the sst_ caller-side evidence-passing convention the
seed's emit has (sst absent from src/ entirely). The fix is to build that
convention in the wheel's emit — not the LMakeClosure handler-stack
hypothesis. This is the central blocker, now the sole frontier to first-light.

mentl/9e8b86f:
A perform site needs two indices, both projected from the effect ROW; the
seed had only the op-slot. This lands the ev-slot — WHICH forwarded handler
record (= which effect) — as the effect's canonical index in the current
fn's row (row_names is sorted-lex, so caller and callee agree by
construction; no coercion table). LEvPerform grows to arity 5
(handle, op_name, ev_slot, op_slot, args); lower_perform computes ev_slot
via lower_compute_ev_index_for_effect (reads the current fn's row from its
own scheme); derive_ev_slots returns one ev per effect in canonical order
(each lexical-LLocal or forwarded-LEvSlotRef per effect); emit_levperform
reads __state[8 + 4*captures + 4*ev_slot].

Verified: repro_multi_effect_ev_slot_collision.mn (two effects, differing
arity) red→GREEN; battery (min_eff/fp/t_freshph/tD/tM/tW) green; trace
suite 66/17 unchanged. This is Koka-style evidence-vector indexing derived
from a richer Boolean row (+ - & ! proves absence), dispatched O(1).

Composing completion (2/2), named: multi-effect HANDLER arm layout. A
handler spanning two effects (graph_handler: GraphWrite+GraphRead, 13 arms)
lays arms in handler-decl order while op_slot is effect-decl-relative —
graph_fresh_ty is GraphWrite op 0 but graph_handler arm 5. The no-waste
ultimate form: per-effect evidence-entries (thin [state_ptr, arms-in-op-
decl-order] views into the SHARED state record), selected by the ev-slot
landed here. Nothing discarded — the state record is reused; the ev-slot
IS the per-effect selector. This is the wheel's fresh_ph trap.

mentl/9e01815:
The previous tagging (Priority 4, "polish, not load-bearing") was
wrong. A language whose substrate is "the graph IS the program"
cannot tolerate a driver that recompiles what the graph already
knows. Re-checking what's already verified is the graph being
disrespected by its own driver.

Reframed as drift mode 10 surfacing at driver level:
**full-recompile-as-if-the-graph-is-stateless.** The substrate is
persistent (Salsa 3.0 / `ty` query-driven incremental was research-
integrated from day one in graph.ka's flat-array + epoch + overlay
shape; `graph_fork(module_name)` is spec-live; every handle carries
its Located reason). The driver pretending the graph is a cache is
the tenth drift mode the substrate already refuses elsewhere.

Coupled with LSP (F.2) — both share the per-piece re-check
operation against cached dependencies. Without incremental
compilation, the thesis "the compiler IS the AI" cannot be tested
at full-recompile speeds; Mentl's gradient becomes a batch job
instead of an oracle.

Substrate is built for this; what pends is the driver:
  - .kai cached env files (per-module {name, Scheme, Reason,
    SchemeKind} quadruples, content-hash keyed)
  - Module DAG resolution from ImportStmt nodes
  - Per-module graph_fork overlays
  - Cache invalidation by downstream-reach
  - LSP didChange wiring shares the operation

Scope: ~400-600 lines across cache/, driver/, LSP wiring.
Couples with the LSP arc (Priority 1, F.2).

Removed from Priority 4 (polish list).

stoop/9eaa148:
A survey of the current tools found the one-sheet editor crowded and the
recurring publication empty. Eight browser tools impose an eight-page
sheet, one-page-zine imposition ships as a Python library with seven
schemas, and one free dither tool carries fourteen styles against our one.
The only product doing numbered issues with an archive does it over email
on a subscription and keeps the archive itself. Nothing in the field has
pieces, a desk, or a shelf.

The prototype deleted in d937b61 had all three. Sixteen views became six,
and every gap the survey found is still readable in git.

PLAN.md proposes the destination those two facts point at: a press, a
format, and an address convention rather than a platform or a cooperative,
ending in one file that is a press for a periodical and rides inside every
issue it prints. It supersedes stages 2 and 3 of DESIGN.md, demotes the
charter to a template a scene may adopt, and stages the work in seven
phases whose gates the build can check. Phases 0 through 4 are things a
scene of two needs in order to publish, so none of them touch the founding
gate.
